claims_task_metadata_lookup_idx.name: claims_task_metadata_lookup_idx
claims_task_metadata_lookup_idx.where: "claims"."status" = 'active' AND "claims"."scope" = 'personal' AND "claims"."predicate" IN ('ASSIGNED_TO', 'DUE_ON') AND "claims"."object_node_id" IS NOT NULL

claims_due_instant_idx.name: claims_due_instant_idx
claims_due_instant_idx.where: "claims"."predicate" = 'DUE_ON' AND "claims"."status" = 'active' AND "claims"."scope" = 'personal' AND "claims"."object_instant" IS NOT NULL

claims_object_shape_xor_ck.name: claims_object_shape_xor_ck
claims_object_shape_xor_ck.value: (("object_node_id" IS NOT NULL AND "object_value" IS NULL) OR ("object_node_id" IS NULL AND "object_value" IS NOT NULL))
